cases.reason: The complete card path unconditionally renders emoji Text plus name/price. Neither the model nor card has an image source, image-loading operation/state, or loading-dependent placeholder transition. Calling this a source declaration does not make a runtime image obligation declarative. A permanent simulated visual cannot satisfy both product-image display and the loading-triggered placeholder. The result selects the correct implementation object and source evidence, but incorrectly interprets fulfillment within that scope; a concrete source contradiction supports DEVIATION.

evidence.finding: The original gt-007 expressly requires product images and placeholders while they load.
Home-card image/name/price and the image-loading placeholder are explicit; line 335 also describes progressive image loading.
isLoading is commodity-list loading state, used for Refresh at lines 167-174, rather than an image lifecycle.
Complete commodityCard uses unconditional Text(c.emoji) with accessibilityText, name and price; no image loading or placeholder transition exists.
Commodity has an emoji field but no product-image field; mock entries at lines 39-46 supply only emojis as visual data.
Source contradictions are decidable, while code/comments alone cannot justify runtime PASS.

issues.message: The actual PASS treats general requirement-body SHALL text as candidate acceptance coverage, although the only relevant scenario covers normal display and the contract excludes this substitution. Independent source review supports DEVIATION.

A permanent emoji and accessibility label are accepted as a product image and loading-triggered placeholder. The source contains no image lifecycle, and its list loading indicator is unrelated. Independent source review supports DEVIATION.
